description: An agent-based simulation modeling the spread of a simple virus within a well-mixed population. Individuals (agents) have health states (Susceptible, Infected, Recovered) and interact to potentially transmit the virus. Infected agents recover after a fixed duration.

behaviors.name: attempt_to_infect_others
behaviors.description: An infected agent attempts to transmit the virus to other agents they encounter.
behaviors.algorithm: If the agent's health_status is 'Infected', in each time step, the agent randomly selects 'average_contacts_per_day' other agents from the population. For each selected agent, if their health_status is 'Susceptible', a random number is generated [0, 1). If this number is less than 'transmission_probability', the susceptible agent is marked for potential infection in this step.

behaviors.name: recover_over_time
behaviors.description: An infected agent recovers after a specified duration.
behaviors.algorithm: If the agent's health_status is 'Infected', increment their 'days_infected' counter. If 'days_infected' reaches or exceeds 'recovery_duration', change the agent's health_status to 'Recovered'.

interactions.name: Transmission
interactions.description: An interaction where an Infected agent comes into contact with a Susceptible agent, with a probability of transmitting the infection.
interactions.trigger: Contact (simulated via random selection by 'attempt_to_infect_others' behavior)
interactions.effect: Changes the health_status of a Susceptible agent to 'Infected' (conditional on transmission_probability).

initialization.procedure: Create 'population_size' Person agents. Assign 'initial_infected_count' agents 'Infected' status, 'days_infected' = 0, and 'ever_infected' = True. Assign the remaining agents 'Susceptible' status, 'days_infected' = 0, and 'ever_infected' = False. Initialize metrics (counts) for day 0.

algorithms.simulation_step: 1. Identify all agents that are currently 'Infected'. 2. Create a temporary list/set of agents newly infected in this step. 3. For each currently 'Infected' agent, execute the 'attempt_to_infect_others' behavior: randomly select 'average_contacts_per_day' other agents. If a selected agent is 'Susceptible', apply the 'transmission_probability' to potentially add them to the temporary 'newly_infected' list. 4. After all 'Infected' agents have attempted infections, iterate through the temporary 'newly_infected' list and update the status of these agents to 'Infected', set 'days_infected' to 0, and 'ever_infected' to True (if not already). 5. Iterate through all agents again. If an agent's status was 'Infected' at the start of the step (and not newly infected in this step), execute the 'recover_over_time' behavior: increment 'days_infected', and if >= 'recovery_duration', change status to 'Recovered'. 6. Collect and record metrics for the current day.

files.name: agent.py
files.description: Defines the Person class with attributes (health_status, days_infected, ever_infected) and potentially methods for state transitions.

files.name: simulation.py
files.description: Manages the population of agents, handles simulation parameters, implements the main simulation step logic ('simulation_step' algorithm), and collects/stores metrics over time.

files.name: main.py
files.description: Sets up the simulation with parameters, initializes the population, runs the simulation for the specified duration, and handles output or visualization of metrics.
